name: Canadian International School (Lakeside)
summary: IB World School on Jurong West with bilingual Mandarin options and a lakeside campus.
body: CIS Lakeside offers IB programmes with a Canadian-influenced pastoral approach and popular bilingual tracks. The west campus suits families living toward Jurong, Clementi, and Bukit Timah west. A second campus presence historically served Tanjong Katong — confirm current campus map when applying.
waitlistNotes: Bilingual tracks fill faster — ask admissions for current openings.
